q1_issues.issue: `easy_identification` fuses an incidental descriptive adjective into a compound kind, which the adjective+noun test bars (fuse only for a term of art, a nationality/origin adjective, a role title or a material adjective).

`clear_container` is the same marginal fusion — transparency describes appearance rather than classifying a subtype, and a descriptive modifier on a plural is supposed to distribute over the members instead.

q2_gaps: a gerund complement of a matrix verb ("consider using X") — the non-finite-complement pattern is stated for to-infinitive control verbs only

a descriptive adjective modifying a NON-SPECIFIC bare-plural object or an abstract nominal inside an oblique ("clear containers", "easy identification") — fusion is barred for incidental description, a bare class symbol has no property slot, and an Inheritance on the kind would assert a false generic
notes: The Directive seal, the purpose-infinitive `To` link, the tenseless complement chain, the addressee-free events and the top-level typing of the definite "the fridge" all follow the instruction set. The two compound fusions look like workarounds for the uncovered modifier case above rather than independent errors.
